QC Lead
Company- Müddət: 2026-10-02 - 2026-11-02
Baxış sayı: 173 Vakansiya № 1015831

Paylaş

Şəhər:

Bakı


 Job Description:

  • Liaise with Client QC Procedures and processes.
  • Use own initiative for ensuring that QC is carried out correctly within the yard.
  • Liaise with Subcontractors for NDT, Hydrotest activities etc.
  • Ensure the correct implementation of approved Company / Project Inspection & Test Plans ans QC Procedures.
  • Monitor the transfer of all unique material identifiers to ensure full material traceability.
  • Monitor welding parameters and use of consumables during installation / construction activities.
  • Ensure QC Inspectors are monitoring procedure qualification and welder’s qualifications.
  • Checks and confirms the availability and suitability of the filler material, preheating material equipment, welding sets, heat treatment equipment / records the extent of all repairs made by welders.
  • Ensuring that all installed pipe / fittings are to the correct specification and that the material is in accordance with the specified drawing and material traceability requirements.
  • Monitor that QC Inspectors carry out visual inspections and they raise appropriate reports.
  • Monitors completion of daily inspection reports, carry out random checking for correctness.
  • Liaise with Welding Engineer regarding welder qualifications and weld procedure qualifications.
  • Ensure that all welding, heat treatment, any hardness testing, Inspection and non-destructive testing comply with the relevant codes and specifications.
  • Monitors repair procedures.
  • Completes and issues all reporting, ensuring correctness.
  • Checks that work is being performed using current approved drawings, specifications and procedures.
  • Ensures that all items (structural, piping etc.) are released from workshop with an Inspection Release Certificate.

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in Quality Control, including proven leadership or supervisory experience
  • Strong knowledge of QA/QC standards, inspection processes, and applicable international codes and specifications

 

Please send your CV to hr@example.com by indicating the position title (QC Lead) in the subject line of your email.
